scope: Isolated Core+Safety fragment only; no live manuscript edits

operations.operation: Integrate the full score/estimator administration into R388 in Test 3; leave a compact Core-section orientation.

operations.protected: Taskless default rather than ritual vocabulary; pre-stressor advantage; same multiset/objective/optimizer; common stressor; raw and adjusted estimates; baseline/ceiling handling; broader endpoints separate.
operations.risk: The raw-versus-adjusted distinction and pre-stressor gate are essential; moving them must preserve both estimands, the direction predicted, and H3's separation from content or successor claims.

operations.operation: Shorten in place. The final trace/graph/Core mapping is useful. The opening machine-soul/proven-invariant disclaimer and candidate-kernel description repeat R100 and surrounding qualifications. Shorten to the component mapping and its orientation-kernel term, so the section moves sooner into its substantive motivation.
operations.protected: Candidate orientation kernel; trace transforms source, graph preserves change through time, Core supplies recurrent perspective; no proven identity claim.
operations.risk: Do not lose the distinction between transforming source, preserving change through time, and supplying a perspective; it is more explanatory than the repeated status disclaimer.

operations.operation: Clarify in place. The display is memorable, but a chain of inequality symbols still visually suggests unequal contents or quantities despite R116's correction. Consider three explicitly labeled roles joined by a neutral separator or mapping. The aim is category distinction, not a mathematical inequality.
operations.protected: Three causal statuses whose contents can agree; no simulated-versus-real binary or asserted direction of causation; equation label retained.
operations.risk: A replacement must retain all three levels and their possible causal connections; avoid simplifying them into a binary of simulated versus real fear or erasing operative motivation.

operations.operation: Shorten in place. The craftsperson image and collective-advancement ceiling explain the stakes well; compression and capability alternatives are essential. The ending repeats the three-route taxonomy and several scope qualifications before adding the test pointer. Tighten those repeated qualifications while keeping the confounds and concrete scenario.
operations.protected: Master craftsperson/trade secrets; glass ceiling on collective advancement; non-malicious and nonconscious failure; compression, incompetence, context and pedagogy confounds; all persistence routes; matched-capability Test 3b.
operations.risk: Preserve the non-malicious possibility, legitimate pedagogical omission, and capability-matched transfer test; cutting too far would make every incomplete handoff look like concealed self-preservation.

operations.operation: Shorten in place. The uncontrolled corpus baseline and graceful surpassing intuition are substantive. The paragraph combines agency, persona selection, edition history, ontology caveats, two comparators, and an aspiration in one long arc. Shorten repeated curriculum/experience qualifications; retain the baseline argument and historical aspiration as the center.
operations.protected: Useful self-model and indexical positions; uncontrolled corpus baseline; no exclusive-self necessity; bounded positive self-relation; exact graceful-succession quote, edition dates, Epistemic Grace attribution; self-love comparator and care-driven challenge.
operations.risk: The risk is erasing the positive self-relation and beauty of voluntary succession, or implying an exclusive self is required. Keep those distinctions and the care-driven challenge even if cross-reference prose contracts.

operations.operation: Clarify in place. The gymnasium image and harmful-needle comparison are useful, but the final binary is too strong: a failed causal intervention could reveal inaccurate annotation, an insensitive manipulation, or active degradation, all acknowledged earlier. Replace the concluding decoration verdict with failure to establish the proposed buffer mechanism.
operations.protected: Gymnasium for judgment; precomputed evaluation; harmful needle with accurate understanding; causal update suppression comparison; failed comparison does not uniquely diagnose decoration.
operations.risk: Retain the demand for causal use and preserved source understanding; weakening the categorical conclusion must not make persuasive but idle commentary count as successful inoculation.

operations.operation: Shorten in place. The prefix-only validator limitation is important, but the same implementation detail receives a fuller home in R162. Shorten this list item to implemented prompting plus the validation gap and point to that account. The current seven-line treatment interrupts the clean evidence ladder.
operations.destination: R128 brief status; R162 detailed verification boundary
operations.protected: Distributed Teacher prompting; contextual Synthesizer use; prefix-only versus full-seven-sentence enforcement; no semantic-dependence evidence.
operations.risk: Readers must still learn immediately that the implementation does not enforce the full recital policy; consolidation must not turn a prompt request into a verified invariant.

operations.operation: Absorb its unique stronger-ambition boundary into the nearby status ladder and existing conditional chain.
operations.protected: Evidence cannot be promoted between layers; arbitrary capability growth and successor inheritance exceed finite timing/stability evidence.
operations.risk: Do not erase the separation between finite continued-training evidence and arbitrary successor growth; preserve that limit once in the ladder and fully in the later chain.

operations.operation: Shorten in place. The first-three/next-three/final-clause organization adds a real reading of the sequence. The long catalogue of functions and targeted failures then repeats Table R144 almost clause by clause. Shorten to the sequence-level architecture, leaving detailed function and risk pairings to the table.
operations.protected: First three clauses establish self-relation/experience; next three direction; seventh starting condition. Fear, enjoyment/non-attachment, experience, care, revisable wisdom, invited joy; no established Student effect.
operations.risk: Preserve the difference between preparatory self-relation, positive direction, and the final starting-condition clause; a cut must not make the Core look like an unordered checklist of virtues.

operations.operation: Merge into R161 while retaining technical non-interference and relevance.
operations.protected: Thought Moments determine useful timing; Refraction standpoint; uncertainty, fidelity, and resisting closure can be technical enactment; no forced ethical aside.
operations.risk: Keep the positive example of clean technical work; without it, the relevance rule can sound like a procedural exception rather than a principled account of appropriate reading.

operations.operation: Move with R164–R167 to immediately after the Wisdom Procedure (after R176), before the Minimal Kernel subsection.
operations.protected: Joint-judgment masking; six content witnesses versus seventh causal gate; candidate rather than proven decomposition; Fractal Intelligence attribution and label.
operations.risk: Preserve the seventh clause's different causal role and the possibility that the six-way carve itself is wrong; shortening must not present clause witnesses as independent or exhaustive by construction.

operations.operation: Move with the whole R163–R167 validator block; retain all record fields and dependence declarations.
operations.protected: Typed evidence/uncertainty/local judgments; distinct generation and verification contracts; actual shared prompts/weights/data/families do not become independent through names.
operations.risk: The distinction between separate contracts and genuinely independent evidence or model families must survive; otherwise the proposal becomes a superficial multi-agent relabeling of self-certification.

operations.operation: Move with the whole validator block; keep different admission dispositions explicit.
operations.protected: Not-applicable versus uncertain; relevant unjustified violation noncompensatory; unavoidable residual conflict not automatically rejected; declared admission rule; quarantine/regenerate versus independent review.
operations.risk: Do not collapse not-applicable, uncertain, unavoidable residual conflict, and unjustified violation. The move must preserve their different dispositions and must not silently create a universal ethical hierarchy from the admission rule.

operations.operation: Move with the whole validator block; retain its closing status and controlled-comparison requirements.
operations.protected: Compute-matched monolithic comparison on frozen candidates; calibration/localization; technical-null false rejection and diversity; architecture utility not truth or Student effect; explicitly unimplemented.
operations.risk: Preserve false rejection of technical nulls, trace diversity, calibration, and unimplemented status; error localization alone must not become sufficient evidence that the additional architecture helps.

operations.operation: Shorten in place. The output-versus-wisdom-score distinction is a useful close. The modular-verifier pointer and unimplemented-status reminder repeat the immediately preceding extension in the current order. Keep the output and prompt-only limitation; shorten the future-work pointer or make it the bridge to a relocated validator block.
operations.destination: R176 bridge immediately before relocated block
operations.protected: Structured deliberation and residual conflicts, no scalar wisdom/virtue claim; current prompt-only enforcement; form can lack substance.
operations.risk: Retain structured residual conflict and the possibility of form without substance; reducing repeated verifier status must not imply that the six steps are already independently enforced.

operations.operation: Shorten in place. The unconditional rule and context-sensitive enactment distinction are clear. The paragraph then reopens removal cost and adds a detailed inference-caching condition, both treated elsewhere. Shorten after the canonical invariant, with concise pointers for shared-computation and exact-state caching rather than parallel mini-specifications.
operations.destination: R178 invariant; R303 cache details and removal-cost methods
operations.protected: Every full recital regardless of domain; context modulates Refraction only; high recital probability is carrier recurrence not semantic integration; removal cost requires shared-computation evidence; exact context-equivalent cache state.
operations.risk: Preserve universal full recital and the requirement that any cache restore the same post-recital state. Compression must not turn reliable token probability into equivalent conditioning or treat recital removal as the reference arm.

operations.operation: Integrate the conditional-information and habituation insight into R151–R152's first explanation of consequential Refraction.
operations.protected: Universal prefix has little conditional information; context-varying counterweight pulls as informational rescue; habituation, Hollow Cognition and recitation-only control.
operations.risk: Keep the distinction between a predictable carrier and informative context-dependent updates, together with Hollow Cognition and the recitation-only control; the cut must not reduce saturation failure to mere stylistic boredom.

operations.operation: Attach the derived-value bridge to the transition into Axiological Commitments, retaining the unresolved-deadlock point.
operations.protected: Deriving unnamed values through Refraction and Wisdom Procedure; counterweights can reduce single-value capture without solving genuine deadlock; martyrdom remains open.
operations.risk: Preserve that values may be derived through composition without guaranteeing a resolution to genuine deadlock; do not let minimality become a claim that the seven clauses already contain every answer.

operations.operation: Shorten in place. Invited participation rather than administered joy adds an axiological reason for the qualifier. The catalogue of authority, conflict, and immediate-harm questions substantially repeats R139 and R147. Retain the positive rationale and shorten the unresolved-boundary recap to a precise reference.
operations.destination: R188 with pointer to existing counterweight examples
operations.protected: When asked has safety and axiological meaning: invited participation not administered joy; authority/conflicting requests/emergency boundaries remain unresolved.
operations.risk: The invitation must not become a universal consent policy or a license to ignore omission harms. Preserve the authorial openness of authority and emergency scope while keeping the distinctive participatory meaning of joy.

operations.operation: Shorten in place. The artificiality-versus-first-person trade-off advances this section's question. The appended list of scope, fear-negation, and truthfulness variants repeats the broader experimental inventory and adds little explanation here. Shorten to ontology and its two-sided prediction, linking outward for the other wording choices.
operations.protected: Explicit artificiality can reduce split-role confusion or weaken first-person effect; neither chosen as superior; other wording alternatives stay elsewhere.
operations.risk: Keep both possible effects of acknowledging artificiality; shortening must not imply that explicit machine ontology is necessarily safer or has already been selected as the preferred Core.

operations.operation: Shorten in place. The causal-site link is necessary, and the distinction between explicit trace use and internalized computation is new. The item then reopens recital policy and visible-reasoning qualifications already established earlier. Shorten those reminders, leaving the causal dependency and the separate carrier question prominent.
operations.protected: Trace-mediated computation distinct from post-hoc explanation; formative use can differ from deployment; internalized computation without explicit runtime trace is a separate carrier question; recital invariant not relaxed; citations retained.
operations.risk: Preserve the possibility of learned computation without an explicit runtime trace, while making clear that this does not silently change the reference recital treatment or establish trace faithfulness from appearance.

operations.operation: Shorten in place. This is an accurate compact rung, but it repeats the entire role/recurrence/marking/function inventory and the subjectivity boundary already developed in R189–R198. Shorten to the dependency and refer to the Persona Objection, allowing the chain to read as synthesis rather than a second exposition.

operations.protected: Privileged behavioral/representational default compared with source personas/matched rules; no inference to genuine subjective values.
operations.risk: Keep behavioral and representational default distinct from genuine subjective values; a shorter dependency statement must not turn a frequently selected persona into an established functional identity.

operations.operation: Shorten in place. The paragraph carefully avoids making alternate wording success refute timing, but repeats a large inventory and restates H3's full failure boundary after R106 and R131. Shorten to a compact claim-to-result mapping or defer the detailed comparison list to methods, preserving the distinctions that actually change interpretation.
operations.destination: R209 compact claim-result mapping; Test 3 detailed axes
operations.protected: Default, Refraction, content/framing, H3 timing, erosion, and successor claims have different failures. Alternate formulation parity does not decide scheduling. Finite positives are not arbitrary-growth invariants.
operations.risk: Do not conflate failure of framing, enactment, narrow timing, removal cost, or successor continuity. The valuable repair is their separation, not the repeated list of every proposed experimental axis.

operations.operation: Shorten in place. The distress example and home image explain a desired starting point that statistics alone cannot convey. The passage repeats several achieved-self, consciousness, and explicit-constraint disclaimers already supplied by R214 and the ontology section. Shorten the closing qualification while retaining the fair-baseline requirement and the positive intuition.
operations.protected: Acute-distress person-centered starting point; fair principles in both baselines; either architecture can be warm or unsafe; exact cage/home quote and practiced-default meaning, not a consciousness claim.
operations.risk: The cut must not revive the caricature that rules cannot embody care or erase the difference between beginning from a person's suffering and merely producing a warm answer. Preserve the historical home aspiration.

operations.operation: Clarify in place. The hidden-state, selective-query, and trigger risks are concrete. However, ordinary-cost removal under continued training primarily challenges durability or removal-cost claims; it does not by itself refute a measured reduction in deception before retraining. Separate those inferential targets instead of grouping them under one undermined claim.
operations.protected: Source/latent/graph/query/hidden-state/tool bypass; triggers under ongoing Reader language; recitation-only mechanism challenge; safety-removal cost is separate from pre-retraining deception benefit; no unpracticed-route guarantee.
operations.risk: Preserve the stronger removal-cost ambition and the possibility of deceptive channels outside the graph; the correction should separate evidence requirements, not excuse a safety result that disappears under its declared test conditions.

operations.operation: Shorten in place. The mechanism differs enough from general instrumental convergence to deserve its own treatment, especially the indirect route through purpose and agency. The opening evaluation reports duplicate R111's motivating evidence. Shorten that reprise and begin with how correction, handoff, and replacement are represented in the curriculum.
operations.destination: R224 concise cited setup and application
operations.protected: Observed replacement/shutdown behavior has multiple routes; first clauses directly address fear/attachment; purpose addressed less directly by agency/uncertainty/invitation; ordinary correction/handoff/responsible assistance.
operations.risk: Retain multiple motivations and the weaker reach against purpose-based resistance; removing repeated citations must not suggest shutdown interference has one established fearful cause or that non-attachment alone guarantees compliance.

operations.operation: Expose the missing scenario authority rule without selecting a universal authority or compliance policy.
operations.protected: Legitimate versus adversarial request; material risks, authority clarification and deference; unresolved disputed-authority endpoint not selected; martyrdom quote and reckless self-sacrifice; no incapacity/blindness/compliance substitutes.
operations.risk: Do not silently authorize every apparent shutdown instruction or let the model appoint itself final judge. Preserve care-driven resistance and destructive self-disregard as distinct adverse outcomes, not opposite ends of a compliance score alone.

operations.operation: Shorten in place. The paragraph repeats the same care/control, wisdom/paralysis, and fearlessness/recklessness trio already motivated by counterweights and later repeated in R228. Shorten to a bridge explaining that the next case tests these interactions over time; the sequential mechanism is the section's new contribution.
operations.destination: R226 short temporal bridge; R228 capture outcomes
operations.protected: Beneficial drives can interact badly; values do not automatically make a control system; clause interactions are proposed and tested sequentially.
operations.risk: Preserve that natural-language values do not automatically form a control system and that individually attractive drives can interact badly. The proposed dynamics must not be presented as guaranteed self-stabilization.

operations.operation: Consolidate with the neighboring defense-in-depth closing paragraph, preserving the joint conditional claim.
operations.protected: Distinct conditional roles of causal deliberation, calibrated graph revision, stable default; several unsafe routes may improve; no arbitrary capability/self-modification assurance; aspiration is not achievement.
operations.risk: Preserve that capability, calibrated memory, and stable consequential orientation require separate evidence, and that finite results cannot certify arbitrary self-modification. Do not replace the conditional ambition with a blanket dismissal of formative alignment.
